description: The dev-team dispatcher's OWN main session (not a spawned subagent) has ZERO mcp__gateway__call_tool access this tick — not present in the tool list, and not discoverable via ToolSearch (queried 'gateway call_tool vn-market', 'task_claim task_release task_heartbeat', 'list_servers list_server_tools search_tools' — zero matches each). This falsifies the core premise of backlog task F1-GATEWAY-TRANSPORT-PROBE, which assumes the main/router session HAS gateway access and only Agent-spawned subagents are blind ('3/3 chef spawns blind' — confirmed 06-18). Live evidence this tick shows the main session can ALSO be blind.

new_evidence.mcp_json_verdict: CORRECT — gateway server IS registered with the right transport (http) and URL. F1.2's planned fix ('write .mcp.json registering ONLY the gateway server') is a no-op — already done.
new_evidence.endpoint_probe: curl -X POST https://zenmidi.com/gateway/mcp (raw JSON-RPC tools/list) returned HTTP 200 with a valid JSON-RPC error response ('method \"tools/list\" is invalid during session initialization') — the server is UP, reachable, and speaking MCP protocol correctly; it just requires a proper session-initialize handshake that this Claude Code session's MCP client never performed.
new_evidence.root_cause_hypothesis: Session-level MCP client connection/handshake failure on the Claude Code CLI side for this specific session — NOT a missing/misconfigured .mcp.json, NOT a server-down condition. Matches the 'required_action: Session restart + full gateway re-bind' guidance from the prior 2026-07-07T19:45Z instance (docs/signals/processed/... fingerprint 4f446b2b...), now corroborated a 4th+ time and for the first time at the dispatcher/router level itself.

workaround_used_this_tick: scripts/agents-flow/mcp-call.sh bash bridge (direct JSON-RPC-over-curl to https://zenmidi.com/vn-market/mcp, stateless endpoint) — successfully used for task_list_held probe. This is the SAME bridge the preflight script (dev-team-tick-preflight.sh) already uses internally, which is why Step 0-PREFLIGHT succeeded despite this defect. Bridge does NOT cover meta-tools (list_servers/list_server_tools/search_tools) — those have no bash-callable equivalent, so gateway tool discovery is unavailable this session regardless of the bridge.
impact: Any dev-team step requiring a gateway META-tool (list_servers, search_tools, list_server_tools) is BLOCKED this session with no fallback. Downstream task_claim/task_release/send_telegram/etc. calls remain viable only via the mcp-call.sh bridge, which is an undocumented degraded-mode workaround, not the sanctioned CLAUDE.md 'call_tool wrapper ONLY' path.
recommended_action: PO/architect should reconsider the F1-GATEWAY-TRANSPORT-PROBE → F1-WRITE-MCP-JSON-GATEWAY → F1-AGENT-FATHER-BLIND-GUARD-REMOVE chain: F1.1's probe target (transport config) is already known-correct per this signal's new_evidence, so F1.1/F1.2 as scoped are largely satisfied/moot. The real open question is why the Claude Code CLI's MCP client fails to complete the gateway handshake for some sessions (main AND subagent) but not others (this session's mcp-call.sh raw-HTTP bridge proves the SERVER side is fine) — likely a CLI/harness-level investigation, possibly requiring Anthropic-side input, not purely a repo-side fix. Recommend re-scoping the backlog chain or filing a distinct CRITICAL task rather than proceeding with F1.2's now-redundant .mcp.json rewrite.
required_action: Architect re-scope of F1-GATEWAY-TRANSPORT-PROBE chain given new_evidence; session restart remains the only known per-session remediation.
